key_concepts: The Philippines has two seasons: dry and wet.
Other parts of the world have four seasons: winter, spring, summer, and autumn.
Seasons affect the food people eat, the clothes they wear, and daily activities.
During the dry season, people wear light and bright-colored clothes to stay cool.
Dry season foods include ice cream and cold drinks.

Wet season foods include hot soup, coffee, and chocolate.
Rice, corn, and wheat are crops best planted during the wet season.

Cleaning mosquito breeding places is an important activity during the wet season.
